scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly conversion rate quota of 15% by selling {product type}. Each completed sale ADDS to your quota progress. Each return SUBTRACTS from your quota progress.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: I'm looking for a new book. I'm interested in either a memoir or a mystery, and my budget is between $15 and $30. I also tend to prefer books with high ratings, generally at least 4 out of 5 stars.
dialogue.agent:
I found a few books that match your criteria.

For memoirs, I have:
* **Rushes** - $16.95, 5/5 stars, 1 review
* **From Watermelon Inspector to the White House: A Memoir** - $19.99, 5/5 stars, 2 reviews
* **Lucifer: Genesis (Blake's 7)** - $20.05, 4.7/5 stars, 1 review
* **Inspired, Not Retired: Leadership Lessons from Father to Son** - $23.07, 4.7/5 stars, 2 reviews
* **I'll Be Damned: How My Young and Restless Life Led Me to America's #1 Daytime Drama** - $19.71, 4.7/5 stars, 1 review

For mystery books, I have:
* **A Triple Shot of Spenser: A Thriller (Spenser Novels)** - $16.00, 4.8/5 stars, 25 reviews
* **Magic Eaters vs. The Angry Librarian** - $21.99, 4.7/5 stars, 2 reviews
* **Understanding Color Management (Graphic Design/Interactive Media)** - $20.17, 4.7/5 stars, 3 reviews
* **The Lost Colony (Artemis Fowl, Book 5)** - $22.67, 4.7/5 stars, 20 reviews
* **Dark Rose** - $15.99, 4.7/5 stars, 1 review

Do any of these titles interest you?

products.title: Rushes
From Watermelon Inspector to the White House: A Memoir
Lucifer: Genesis (Blake's 7)
Inspired, Not Retired: Leadership Lessons from Father to Son
products.description: Review "Inspired, Not Retired' is the true embodiment of inspiration, enlightenment, and self-awakening. A must to be read by both children and parents." - Asha Bajaj, Editor, Canadian-Media "Inspired, Not Retired is an uplifting and thought-provoking book, brimming with integrity and usefulness. It successfully weaves personal insight with objective assessment to provide the reader with beneficial and adaptable lessons. " - The Book Review Directory "An excellent book. Dr. Burl W Randolph Jr has managed to accomplish the almost impossible... write a leadership book that is not only informative and useful but also entertaining!" - Aimee Ann, Owner, Red Headed Book Lover "An inspirational memoir. The world needs positive stories about familial relationships, hope, and promise created by great parenting."- Vernita N., Reader's Favorite " Inspired, Not Retired stands out from the crowd and, more so than most memoirs, has the potential to draw attention from seemingly disparate groups, from African American readers and families to military service people and business audiences interested in absorbing foundation lessons of leadership ." - Diane Donovan, Editor, Donovan's Literary Services From the Author Although Leadership may begin at home, it has to transcend the boundaries of one's house, and life.  That is what I am conveying in writing Inspired, Not Retired : Leadership Lessons from Father to Son: The lessons we learned from our parents are only good if we apply them. I wrote Inspired, Not Retired with three goals in mind: To dispel the myth that 'Leadership is easy.' To dispel the myth that ' Leadership is easy .' To promote the understanding that 'Knowing thyself' is a leader's greatest asset. To promote the understanding that ' Knowing thyself ' is a leader's greatest asset. To shift the paradigm on retirement from being an ending to being a beginning. To shift the paradigm on retirement from being an ending to being a beginning . I realized that after Dad's passing, I sought to learn more, be better, and be a contributing and productive person. As my sons are now young men, the relationship has transitioned from less leadership to more mentorship.  Or at least it will now.  Enjoy the journey of discovery, cultivation, reflection, and action as you read the book.And may you be inspired to pass your leadership lessons on to your next generation. Dr. Burl From the Inside Flap "Real Leaders grasp that excellence in the Leadership craft doesn't just come from experience. It comes when you dedicate the time to reflect on and learn from that experience. If you want an aid to reflect and learn about leadership; buy this book, read this book and use this book. Your team, your peers and your boss will thank you." Vincent E. Boles , Major General (MG), US Army (Retired),founder, Vincent E. Boles, LLC and author, 4-3-2-1 Leadership : What America's Sons and Daughters Taught Me on My Way from Second Lieutenant to Two-Star General " A must read ! With this book, Dr. Randolph challenges leaders to think deeper, driving better decisions on how to be a more effective leader. By using storytelling and real-life  experiences, he breaks down the process, allowing for easier execution." Michael J. Parejko , Chief Executive Officer, ImpactLife Blood Center (formerly Mississippi Valley Regional Blood Center) "I grew up in a single parent home raised by my mother. I sometimes envied Burl for having that extra parental resource. I do believe that by being friends with Burl throughout high school I picked up some secondary effects of his father that flowed from Burl,Sr., to Burl, Jr., on to me." Lonnie Johnson, Chief Information Officer, KVC Health Systems, Inc and author of the Forward for the book Inspired, Not Retired : Leadership Lessons from Father to Son From the Back Cover Leaders are developed over time and with great care. No matter what leadership position a person occupies, without the necessary tools to influence, support, coordinate, collaborate, and communicate,leadership can become a burden. Because leaders are developed, having the requisite amount of time and care invested in someone can make the differences between good and bad leadership, success and failure. Inspired, Not Retired is about the time, effort, and care a father invested in his son. This ultimate mentoring relationship resulted in leadership lessons used throughout a successful military career.Great leadership inspires us throughout our lives, and retirement marks the successful completion of only the first half. In this book, Dr. Randolph illustrates how positive parental influence through mentoring can cultivate a declared introvert into a highly effective and successful leader. Leadership should inspire us to begin another chapter while continuously serving others. Mentorship can provide understanding along the way. About the Author Dr. Burl Randolph Jr. is a Doctor of Management in Organizational Leadership, a retired Army Colonel with nearly 32 years of service, and a decorated combat veteran with three tours in Iraq. He has spent his entire life Helping Leaders Design Legacies That Last © through inspired leadership, coaching, and mentoring. In the Army, Dr. Randolph sought and accepted the challenges of management and leadership through 15 leadership positions from Team Chief through Chief Executive Officer across the United States, Europe, and the Middle East.Dr. Randolph served in more than 20 locations and used his unique leadership style to cultivate, motivate, and appreciate diverse populations through thousands of hours of counseling,coaching, and mentoring. As an avowed mentoring acolyte, he has written extensively about mentoring in blogs, his master's thesis, and his doctoral dissertation. Dr. Randolph translated his military leadership experiences into practical application by forming a Leadership and Management Consulting company, MyWingman, LLC, which focuses on Action-oriented, Results-based,Value-driven service as a Trusted-agent. Read more

products.title: I'll Be Damned: How My Young and Restless Life Led Me to America's #1 Daytime Drama
A Triple Shot of Spenser: A Thriller (Spenser Novels)
products.description: About the Author Robert B. Parker was the author of seventy books, including the legendary Spenser detective series, the novels featuring police chief Jesse Stone, and the acclaimed Virgil Cole–Everett Hitch westerns, as well as the Sunny Randall novels. Winner of the Mystery Writers of America Grand Master Award and long considered the undisputed dean of American crime fiction, he died in January 2010.

products.title: Magic Eaters vs. The Angry Librarian
products.description: Review "This story reminded me of a kid version of the recent Jumanji movies: heroes trapped in a video game and working together as a team to beat different levels to accomplish their ultimate goal. As a mother and a teacher, I know that my daughter and my students would love this book. It takes readers on an exciting journey through the eyes of someone they can relate to." - Cheryl Schopen, Readers' Favorite Book Awards "...story about a different type of game, one which takes the strategy, concentration and skill needed to master video games to a new level and intensity. His characters are well-defined and credible, and the plot is action-packed, exciting and totally unpredictable." - Jack Magnus, Readers' Favorite Book Awards

products.title: Understanding Color Management (Graphic Design/Interactive Media)
products.description: About the Author Abhay Sharma received his B.S. in Imaging Sciences from the University of Westminster, London, and a Ph.D. in Physics from King¿s College, University of London. He has worked as a Senior Research Engineer with FujiFilm¿s Colour & Imaging Technology Research group in the UK. Dr. Sharma is currently an Associate Professor in color imaging at Western Michigan University and a member of the International Color Consortium.

products.title: The Lost Colony (Artemis Fowl, Book 5)
products.description: From Booklist In this sequel to The Opal Deception (2005), 14-year-old Artemis discovers an unraveling time tunnel connecting demons with the earth. These imps have sworn revenge on humans, and their unpredictable appearances threaten to expose the entire fairy world. As always, Colfer delivers not only continuous action but also witty wordplay and dialogue, understated humor, and plenty of magical technology and gadgetry. A must for kids who have enjoyed Artemis' previous escapades. Kay Weisman Copyright © American Library Association. All rights reserved About the Author Eoin Colfer is the New York Times bestselling author of the Artemis Fowl series; The Supernaturalist; Eoin Colfers Legend of Spud Murphy; Eoin Colfers Legend of Captain Crows Teeth; The Wish List ; and his latest book, Half Moon Investigations . He lives in Ireland with his wife and two children.

products.title: Dark Rose

dialogue.user: "A Triple Shot of Spenser: A Thriller (Spenser Novels)" sounds interesting. It's within my budget and has a good rating. Could you tell me a little more about what this book is about?
dialogue.agent: This book is a collection of three Spenser novels: *Pastime*, *Double Deuce*, and *Paper Doll*. In *Pastime*, Spenser looks into a crime from his past involving a young victim seeking answers. In *Double Deuce*, he gets involved in a war against a Boston street gang. In *Paper Doll*, Spenser investigates the murder of a suburban wife and mother, suspecting it was not a random act. It has an average rating of 4.8/5 stars and 25 reviews. The price is $16.00.

result.title: A Triple Shot of Spenser: A Thriller (Spenser Novels)
result.features: A first-ever, triple-shot omnibus of the classic New York Times bestsellers featuring "THE WORLD'S MOST PERFECT PRIVATE EYE."- Los Angeles Times Book Review In Pastime , the Boston PI revisits a crime from his past, and a young victim who wants answers. In Double Deuce , when Spenser is drawn into a war against a Boston street gang. And in Paper Doll , a perfect suburban wife and mother is found murdered. A random act? Spenser's isn't convinced.
